'''Basa-Kontagora''' is an extinct [[Kainji language]]<ref>{{Glottolog|bass1259|Bassa-Kontagora}}</ref> of [[Nigeria]]. It is spoken in [[Mariga, Nigeria|Mariga]], [[Niger State]], near [[Kontagora]] and the [[Basa languages|Basa]] homeland. It is estimated that Basa-Kontagora has less than 10 native speakers as of 2010.
